card.name: Words just before corticosteroid
card.fires_on: The word right before "corticosteroid(s)", mostly "systemic", also "high-dose" and the start of "corticosteroids" itself. It appears in drug-label text on immune side effects and steroid use.

modes.label: Systemic before steroid
modes.description: The word "systemic" comes just before corticosteroids in advice on treating immune reactions.

modes.label: Inside corticosteroid
modes.description: The first piece of the word corticosteroids after "systemic".

modes.label: Dose wording before steroid
modes.description: Dose wording such as "high-dose" or a space before a steroid dose amount.

card.plain: It fires on the word just before "corticosteroids" in a label, usually "systemic", and predicts that steroid word next.
